findings.claim: DepthStep now permits one level beyond MaximumObjectGraphDepth. DepthStep increments reader.Depth after this guard, so with a configured maximum of 1 the first call leaves Depth at 1 and the second call now also succeeds (1 > 1 is false), leaving Depth at 2; only the third call throws. This also means a maximum of int.MaxValue can no longer reject at the boundary before Depth is incremented, potentially overflowing it.

receipt_plan.detail: Create security = MessagePackSecurity.TrustedData.WithMaximumObjectGraphDepth(1) and a MessagePackReader. Call security.DepthStep(ref reader) twice. The second call must throw InsufficientExecutionStackException: it does on base with >=, but does not on head with >.
